title: Sen. Jim Justice Urges Administration to Reconsider ICE Enforcement Approach
detail: Sen. Jim Justice (R-WV) said the Trump administration should reconsider its immigration enforcement approach, joining criticism of a crackdown that has roiled rural communities ahead of the midterms. Local reporting described sweeping enforcement actions in southwest Kansas.
